messages:
jamie: drafting internal note for v3.0.2 - want the blurb and pin confirmed before we schedule the blast. can we run a staged deploybot dry-run?
ana: yes please. i've got a 2-line blurb ready: 'v3.0.2: improved batching logic to cut tail latency. No API changes. See rollout details.'
lucas: i need the exact pinned artifact for Dedicated customers. don't want ambiguity during handoffs.
rahul: pinned artifact = inference-runtime@v3.0.2 (git: d4f7e9b). calling that out in the notes now.
jamie: cool. add rollback rules too: auto rollback to v3.0.1 if 3m error rate > 1% OR p95 latency regresses by 40%.
ana: can we also mute noisy metric alerts during the first 10m of canary? otherwise oncall will get flooded.
oncall: we prefer not to mute completely, but we can raise thresholds for the initial 10m window. set them in the alert policy.
jamie: @deploy-bot can you run a dry-run announce that mirrors prod text so docs team can see final phrasing? tag this thread id 9680012345.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. running staging dry-run for thread 9680012345. will output messages flagged [staging-dry-run]. ETA 2m.
deploy-bot: dry-run messages:
- "[STAGING DRY-RUN] Release v3.0.2 scheduled. Canary: us-central 20m -> ramp 60% over 20m. Pin: inference-runtime@v3.0.2 (d4f7e9b)"
- "Rollback policy: 3m error rate > 1% OR p95 latency +40% -> rollback to v3.0.1"
- "Owners: jamie (release), lucas (customer comms), rahul (deploy), oncall (pager)"
lucas: timings look fine. can we avoid EU midnight window? customers in EU shouldn't see canary during 01:00-04:00 CET.
rahul: adding blackout: eu region blocked 01:00-04:00 CET. updating deploy config snippet.
jamie: paste snippet here so docs can include it in the release notes appendix.
rahul: snippet: ```
canary: region: "us-central" duration: "20m"
ramp: to: "60%" duration: "20m"
blackout: region: "eu" start: "01:00+01:00" end: "04:00+01:00"
alerts: initial_adjust: {error_rate: "1.5%", latency_p95_increase: "50%", window: "10m"}
```
nana: nice. i'll fold the snippet into the internal note under 'Ops details'. also adding a concise customer-facing line for account reps.
jamie: can someone volunteer to post the internal blast? need it to go out T-8 before canary starts so folks can pin and review.
lucas: i can post and pin. will schedule for 2024-05-02T11:52:00Z (T-8).
oncall: once posted, i'll run through the pager playbook and confirm the thresholds reflect that 'initial_adjust' block.
jamie: thanks. small editorial: change 'No API changes' to 'No API changes; backward compatible' in the blurb. keeps expectations clear.
nana: updated. final blurb: 'v3.0.2: improved batching to reduce tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.' two lines ready.
rahul: deploy config pinned and staged in deploy service. I'll flip to prod at T. leaving this thread open for any final copy edits. :shipit:
lucas: posted and pinned at scheduled time. tagging owners and the accounts list. closing thread after oncall ack.
oncall: acked. verified pager thresholds and blackout applied. all good.
